Jonas — quick update on latency ask. Short version: we can present two SLO bundles for critical read/write routes: 
- Standard (default): P95 ~120ms, P99 ~300ms, supporting up to 5k rps per pool.
- Premium (dedicated low-latency): P95 ~45ms, P99 ~120ms, requires reserved GPU pools + pinned model variants.

Notes: 
- Tail latency depends heavily on model context length; if Acme uses long sequences we should call that out.
- Quantization/half-precision options reduce cost but add ~5-10ms to average infer time on some models.

I've added details to exec_asks_tracker.csv under rows 4-6 and set ownership for the Premium SLO presentation to myself (ETA Thu EOD).

Aditya
